Upstream: https://github.com/rust-skia/rust-skia
Published package: https://crates.io/api/v1/crates/skia-bindings/0.153.3/download
Published package SHA256: eb325787c91b3f6c34a7c6f2b8a2297b20292d733ca53a08c233e5028aec49af
Published package VCS commit: b7f043e0b1e2a850e702245de811f01df1f6b0ff
Published package VCS path: skia-bindings
Skia revision from package metadata: m153-0.101.2

The vendored package retains all 58 files from the published archive byte-for-byte,
except build.rs, build_support/skia_bindgen.rs and src/graphite.cpp.

build_support/skia_bindgen.rs carries the exact upstream PR 1335 opaque-type
additions for std::__rebind_alloc.* and std::__hash_table.*.
Patch: https://github.com/rust-skia/rust-skia/pull/1335
Merged commit: 16bc1d24ae3cc62474583f3388df6e3d883fafb3
Issue: https://github.com/rust-skia/rust-skia/issues/1331
This prevents bindgen 0.72.1 from emitting an unresolved _Traits alias when
generating bindings against Apple clang 21 and macOS 27 libc++ headers.
src/graphite.cpp supplies a fresh image-conversion provider for each recorder
whose caller did not provide one. Skia m153 otherwise drops non-Graphite image
draws, including raster-backed image shaders. The provider converts through
SkImages::TextureFromImage and retains at most 512 entries / 512 MiB of the
textureSize() estimate, keyed by original image uniqueID and mipmap requirement.
Zero-size estimates and oversized textures are not retained. The recorder GPU
default budget is raised to 1 GiB; nondefault caller budgets are preserved.
Caller-provided image providers are preserved.
An upload failure rejects the snapped recording with a native diagnostic instead
of returning a frame with omitted artwork. Failed recordings clear cached images
so discarded uploads cannot be reused. A non-owning thread-local registry follows
Skia's recorder thread-affinity contract and is erased before recorder deletion.
The synchronous readback shim keeps asynchronous result state alive through heap
shared ownership. Its callback never retains or writes the caller's buffer, so a
failed submit or bounded completion timeout cannot leave a dangling callback.
API contract: https://skia.googlesource.com/skia/+/refs/heads/chrome/m153/include/gpu/graphite/ImageProvider.h
Default provider: https://skia.googlesource.com/skia/+/refs/heads/chrome/m153/src/gpu/graphite/Recorder.cpp
build.rs bypasses upstream binary-cache downloads for Graphite so its compiled
native shim cannot omit the local provider/readback changes. Graphite rejects
no-compile and FORCE_SKIA_BINARIES_DOWNLOAD overrides. CPU-only binary-cache and
documentation behavior are unchanged. SKIA_SOURCE_DIR + SKIA_LIBRARY_SEARCH_PATH
can import engine archives, then compile the local native shim and bindings.
No Skia engine source or Rust API wrapper is patched.

LICENSE is added because the published archive omits the upstream root license.
License source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rust-skia/rust-skia/b7f043e0b1e2a850e702245de811f01df1f6b0ff/LICENSE
License SHA256: 4b33ed5b329a3a79eb1243fd91373c68b0ae0b9df7503bfc50d0c5253adf1b9a
FANTA-PROVENANCE.txt is the only other added file.
